'''Eobbim Figh''' was a [[Mhingxin]] gossiper and informant roaming [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley's]] cantina's and streets. He once told [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] some interesting information about Bossk's failing popularity in the bounty hunter trade and the whereabouts of Bossk's enemy [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="Hard Merchandise" />
